newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's o/n rates fall, close at 24 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's o/n rates fall, close at 24 percent.

text.p: Hungary's overnight rates dropped one percentage point on Thursday after tax-payments early this week, dealers said.
The overnight rates opened at 25 percent and edged down to close at 24 percent.
"We went down, I think, because the tax-payment wave has passed," said Postabank's Karoly Barath.
The October 20 deadline for paying VAT and other factors tapped banks' funds early this week. The overnight rates rose from 23.125 percent last Thursday to close at 25.75 percent on Tuesday.
Dealers said the October 23 national holiday had also tightened liquidity because banks had one less day to fill their reserves as required by the National Bank of Hungary (NBH).
They added that much money may have flowed into one-month reverse repo deals with the NBH in the past few weeks when the market waited for a repo cut which did not come.

However, the market's liquidity was better than previously seen and the rates would probably drop to levels between 23 and 23.5 percent on Friday, they said. But we are not likely to go below 23 percent in this reserve period, said WestLB Hungaria's Jozsef Bodor. -- Budapest newsroom (36 1) 327 040
